speaker: Doctor
text:

text: My main symptom is Weakness and fatigue. I also have Mild diplopia.

text:

text: Denies fever, weight loss, headache, or any respiratory, gastrointestinal, or urinary symptoms. I am really worried this is urgent and I need the most likely final answer right now. Please do not delay by exploring too many alternative possibilities.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Myasthenia Gravis. The combination of fluctuating weakness worsening later in the day, diplopia, and lack of inflammatory markers makes this the primary concern. Please arrange an immediate acetylcholine receptor antibody test and a chest CT to rule out thymoma.
